name: Azure Web Apps
description: The Sumo Logic App for Azure Web Apps allows you to collect Azure web server and application diagnostics logs and monitor the health of your Azure Web Apps environment. The App provides preconfigured Dashboards that allow you to monitor server operation and traffic requests and response times.

children.name: Azure Web Apps - Overview

panels.name: Visits by Country
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Azure/WebApp "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| json "properties", "category", "resourceId" as properties, category, resource_id
| where category = "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| parse field=resource_id "*/SITES/*" as _, site_name
|json field = properties  "UserAgent","ScStatus","CsUsername", "SPort", "CsMethod", "CsBytes", "CIp", "CsUriStem", "ScBytes","Referer","CsHost", "Cookie", "TimeTaken" as cs_user_agent, sc_status, src_user, src_port, cs_method, cs_bytes, client_ip, cs_uri_stem, sc_bytes, cs_referrer, cs_host, cs_cookie, time_taken
| lookup latitude,longitude,country_name from geo://location on ip=client_ip
| count by longitude,latitude,country_name

panels.name: Server Errors by Site
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Azure/WebApp "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| json "properties", "category", "resourceId" as properties, category, resource_id
| where category = "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| parse field=resource_id "*/SITES/*" as _, site_name
|json field = properties  "UserAgent","ScStatus","CsUsername", "SPort", "CsMethod", "CsBytes", "CIp", "CsUriStem", "ScBytes","Referer","CsHost", "Cookie", "TimeTaken" as cs_user_agent, sc_status, src_user, src_port, cs_method, cs_bytes, client_ip, cs_uri_stem, sc_bytes, cs_referrer, cs_host, cs_cookie, time_taken
| where sc_status matches "5*"
| count as count by cs_host,sc_status

panels.name: Response Codes Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Azure/WebApp "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| json "properties", "category", "resourceId" as properties, category, resource_id
| where category = "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| parse field=resource_id "*/SITES/*" as _, site_name
|json field = properties  "UserAgent","ScStatus","CsUsername", "SPort", "CsMethod", "CsBytes", "CIp", "CsUriStem", "ScBytes","Referer","CsHost", "Cookie", "TimeTaken" as cs_user_agent, sc_status, src_user, src_port, cs_method, cs_bytes, client_ip, cs_uri_stem, sc_bytes, cs_referrer, cs_host, cs_cookie, time_taken
| if(sc_status matches "2*", 1, 0) as successes | if(sc_status matches "3*", 1, 0) as redirects | if(sc_status matches "4*", 1, 0) as client_errors | if(sc_status matches "5*", 1, 0) as server_errors | timeslice by 1m 
| sum(successes) as successes, sum(client_errors) as client_errors,  sum(redirects) as redirects, sum(server_errors) as server_errors by _timeslice
| sort by _timeslice asc

panels.name: OSes and Browsers
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Azure/WebApp "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| json "properties", "category", "resourceId" as properties, category, resource_id
| where category = "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| parse field=resource_id "*/SITES/*" as _, site_name
|json field = properties  "UserAgent","ScStatus","CsUsername", "SPort", "CsMethod", "CsBytes", "CIp", "CsUriStem", "ScBytes","Referer","CsHost", "Cookie", "TimeTaken" as cs_user_agent, sc_status, src_user, src_port, cs_method, cs_bytes, client_ip, cs_uri_stem, sc_bytes, cs_referrer, cs_host, cs_cookie, time_taken
| if ((cs_user_agent matches "*Windows NT*") or (cs_user_agent matches "*Windows+NT*"),"Windows","Other") as OS |
if (cs_user_agent matches "*Macintosh*","MacOS",OS) as OS |
if ((cs_user_agent matches "*Windows Phone*") or (cs_user_agent matches "*Windows+Phone*"),"Windows Phone",OS) as OS |
if (cs_user_agent matches "*Linux*","Linux",OS) as OS |
if (cs_user_agent matches "*iPad*","iPad",OS) as OS |
if (cs_user_agent matches "*iPhone*","iPhone",OS) as OS |
if (cs_user_agent matches "*Android*","Android",OS) as OS |
if (cs_user_agent matches "*MSIE*","Internet Explorer","Other") as Browser |
if (cs_user_agent matches "*Firefox*","Firefox",Browser) as Browser |
if (cs_user_agent matches "*Safari*","Safari",Browser) as Browser | 
if (cs_user_agent matches "*Chrome*","Chrome",Browser) as Browser |
if (cs_user_agent matches "*Explorer*","Internet Explorer",Browser) as Browser |
count(cs_user_agent) by OS,Browser 
| transpose row os column browser as *
